name: answers-review
title: Answers review
description: Check your answers before sending: grouped answers in a summary list, each with a Change link and a clear Not provided marker.
docs: Pass groups (title, rows of key, label, value, files, href or onChange, error). Each group is a section with a heading and a real description list. A row with an href gets a Change link; otherwise it calls its own onChange or the review's onChange(key). A row with no answer says "Not provided" in muted text and offers Add instead of Change. Text keeps its line breaks and long words wrap; files are listed by name. Every link says "Change" and then the question, for screen readers, and is described by the row's error when there is one, so the page can be where a blocked submit gets fixed. headingLevel sets the section titles; emptyText and labels carry the words. It has no hooks of its own, so a Server Component can render it when every row has an href.
